study.question: Under the frozen field-adapted DIN reference, do 16 directly exposed action/match count statistics and 16 freshness statistics provide incremental validation value, separately and conditionally, beyond redundant copies of the normalized history vector?
study.hypothesis: Observed references improve from static AUC 0.6050036145 to mean pooling 0.6102261137 and normalized target attention 0.6133619861. Source inspection shows category, brand, action and age are summed into one event embedding and compressed to one normalized 16-vector. A normalized weighted mean cannot distinguish uniform replication of identical event representations. Explicit bounded log counts may expose otherwise difficult multiplicity evidence; action/match-conditional mean one-day decay may add temporal information beyond those counts. These are provisional mechanism hypotheses, not diagnoses established by the aggregate AUC gains.

nearest_work.difference: Retain its complete static branch and normalized attention vector. Replace two redundant 16-vector copies with deterministic count/freshness readouts, holding the widened head parameter shapes fixed across the factorial.

DIN Eq.3 and lines 272-277 already motivate unnormalized learned attention to retain intensity. The local reference uses softmax, unlike that aspect of original DIN. Here the normalized learned vector stays intact and explicit action-by-field count/freshness scalars are exposed to the head. This is a local representation contrast, not a new intensity principle or an exact DIN reproduction. Priority and comprehensive novelty remain unverified. An unnormalized attention control remains a consequential next comparison before stronger mechanism or prior-work claims.

The author README confirms category, brand and behavior type without item history. Respect these substitutions; no DMR auxiliary matching loss or item-level reconstruction is imported. The publisher full paper was not available through this source, so detailed DMR mechanism equivalence is unresolved.

inherited_components: All baseline field embeddings and padding conventions; category/brand embeddings shared with history
Additive category+brand+action+log2-age embeddings and existing 64-unit PReLU attention
Normalized masked attention and its original 16-dimensional readout
Static concatenation, ReLU MLP [128,64], output logit, fixed host training and scorer
study.proposed_difference: Predeclare groups [all valid events, target-category bucket match, target-brand bucket match, both matches] crossed with actions [pv,cart,fav,buy]. Count block C has 16 scalars C[g,a]=log(1+n[g,a])/log(129). Time block T has 16 scalars T[g,a]=sum(exp(-max(age_seconds,0)/86400))/max(n[g,a],1), with zero for empty cells. No learned projections or auxiliary losses are added. Retain the original summary h and append two 16-wide slots. The 2x2 replacement factorial uses [h,h,h], [h,C,h], [h,h,T], [h,C,T] after static features. All variants compute C and T even when unused. Each has 4096 more dense parameters than baseline-din (32 extra head inputs x 128 hidden units), and equal parameter counts to one another. The explicit evidence representation is bounded at 32 scalars; no claim that the entire model is smaller is made.
predictions: The count effect AUC(count_only)-AUC(repeat_control) will be positive if the explicit count package is useful; conditional effect AUC(count_freshness)-AUC(freshness_only) measures its increment with freshness present.

Freshness adds information beyond multiplicity if AUC(count_freshness)-AUC(count_only)>0. AUC(freshness_only)-AUC(repeat_control) alone cannot isolate timing because absent cells also signal presence.
Report the interaction A11-A10-A01+A00 and all four simple effects. Positive combined performance alone does not imply independent benefits.

The main evidence comparison is the full-population validation AUC, with unweighted Logloss and measured cost reported alongside it. An initial AUC increment of at least 0.0002 triggers prioritization for paired repetition; smaller gains remain unresolved rather than declared null.

Exploratory existing slices: category-match present/absent, empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history, behavior present/absent, hour and training-frequency groups. Retain host sample/positive/negative counts. No new bin fitting, slice significance claims or slice-driven model selection.

Empty histories give exactly zero summary and scalar evidence before the prediction head, but different learned weights can still change empty-history predictions. Only 310 positives occur in this baseline slice; interpret it cautiously.
falsifiers: If count_only does not improve on the repeat control and the count increment with freshness is also nonpositive across paired repetitions, the tested explicit count package lacks support under this protocol.

If the freshness increment conditional on counts is nonpositive across paired repetitions, this one-day mean-decay representation does not support incremental temporal value; this does not refute all temporal mechanisms.
If repeat_control improves as much as the candidate relative to baseline-din, improvement over baseline alone is insufficient evidence for useful new statistics.

Nonfinite logits, padding-sensitive evidence, nonzero matches to missing bucket zero, inconsistent parameter counts across variants, or exceeding host trial limits invalidate a run rather than provide scientific counterevidence.
An effect that disappears under paired seed repetitions or is accompanied by materially worse Logloss/cost must be reported as unstable or a tradeoff, not a successful mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Inactive 16-dimensional slots repeat the retained DIN summary. This matches parameter count and information but changes redundant parameterization and input scales relative to the original baseline.
Time-only statistics reveal occupied match/action cells through their zero convention; only the time effect conditional on counts avoids that particular presence confound.
Counts jointly expose action, category, brand and joint-match structure. This round does not isolate those components.
Bucket equality is not guaranteed raw-identity equality; unknown/missing target bucket zero never matches. Unknown bucket conventions beyond zero are not documented.
Statistics cover only the supplied truncated history, not lifetime activity.
A single seed, a selected checkpoint and exploratory slices do not establish significance or generalization.
The existing DIN-style baseline is not faithful to original DIN normalization. Benefits may recover known interest intensity rather than demonstrate a distinct scientific advance.
Direct features can ease optimization, change feature scaling, or regularize the representation without recovering information wholly absent from the learned history vector.
Temporal distribution shift, static snapshots with undocumented as-of dates, history truncation and hash collisions may limit production transfer.
The 86400-second decay scale is predeclared and uncalibrated. A failed time block may reflect its particular scale or mean aggregation rather than unavailable temporal signal.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: run://r-001 context.protocol: full unit estimated 704.3729729604242 s, observed baseline-din wall 610.8194986134768 s; trial cap 1760.9324324010606 s; initial remaining 86399.65723347664 s. These are host estimates, not measured costs for the new code.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Initial four-cell suite expected about 2817.5 s, conservative sum of caps 7043.8 s. Reserve eight additional full-trial caps (14087.5 s) for discriminating follow-ups such as unnormalized attention, matching-versus-general counts or a smaller replacement representation, including failures/diagnostics. Additional work requires later phase authorization; no training in this coding phase.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve twelve additional full-trial caps (21131.2 s) for a frozen candidate/closest-control suite with paired seeds 42,43,44 on validation only. Reuse successful seed-42 records only when source/config/protocol/checkpoint identities match. Final selection and controls must freeze before those assessments; no test feedback is available. Report omitted repetitions and retain single-seed claims as preliminary.
cost_plan.stop_rule: All preparation, source retrieval, diagnostics, failures and retries are charged by the host. Never exceed remaining ledger or the per-trial cap. Preserve assessment reserve before proposing additional research. Unknown execution state requires checking the receipt before retrying. Stop on integrity failure, hard limit or no useful admissible experiment; do not interpret resource exhaustion as scientific success.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Read exact-version primary mechanism lines 250-277; original DIN already preserves intensity without softmax. This motivates an explicit limitation of the local normalized reference and prevents a novelty claim about intensity.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Keep normalized history attention; expose action-by-field count and freshness scalars rather than modifying attention normalization.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Deterministic evidence readout with factorial replacement controls; not original DIN unnormalized weighted summation. Novelty remains unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: No gain versus matched redundancy, or gains no larger than known unnormalized attention in a future controlled comparison.
